class.name: GameplayTagQuery
class.brief_description: A reusable predicate over gameplay tag containers.
class.description: Use a query to share a tag condition between actions. Tag groups check explicit requirements using hierarchical or exact matching. Query groups combine child predicates. Factories capture their operands when called, so later edits to a requirement container leave the query unchanged. A default query has no condition and always fails.

method.name: all_queries
method.description: Creates a query that requires every child in [param queries] to match. An empty array passes. A null child makes the factory return [code]null[/code].

method.name: all_tags
method.description: Creates a query that requires every explicit tag in [param terms]. An empty container passes. Enable [param exact] to require explicit membership of each tag. A missing container makes the factory return [code]null[/code].

method.name: any_queries
method.description: Creates a query that requires at least one child in [param queries] to match. An empty array fails. A null child makes the factory return [code]null[/code].

method.name: any_tags
method.description: Creates a query that requires at least one explicit tag in [param terms]. An empty container fails. Enable [param exact] to test explicit membership. A missing container makes the factory return [code]null[/code].

method.name: matches
method.description: Tests [param tags] against the query. A missing subject container or an unset query fails.

method.name: no_queries
method.description: Creates a query that passes when none of [param queries] match. An empty array passes. A null child makes the factory return [code]null[/code].

method.name: no_tags
method.description: Creates a query that passes when no explicit requirement from [param terms] is met. An empty container passes. Enable [param exact] to check absence of explicit membership. A missing container makes the factory return [code]null[/code].
